title: TS2Python wire v4 — bar
description: Payload emitted by EL_PublishBar: a complete OHLC bar at the interval named in `tf`. Frame 2 of a 2-frame ZMQ message; frame 1 is the UTF-8 symbol topic. See envelope.md and semantics.md — schema validation alone is NOT sufficient to implement a correct binding.

v.description: Wire version — the shape of this envelope. Decided by the DLL.

pv.description: Publisher convention version — which rules produced the NUMBERS, as opposed to v, which says where the fields are. Decided by the EasyLanguage indicator, which lives in the user's TradeStation install and does not update when the DLL or a binding does. 0 means undeclared (the plain EL_Init path, i.e. an exporter older than this field): read intraday vol as up-tick share volume alone, about half of what traded. 1 means semantics.md §3.4 is implemented — vol is total share volume on every timeframe and intraday tc is 0. An unknown value must be logged, never refused: the fields are still readable and the data is not damaged. See envelope.md.

tf.description: Interval this bar covers. Same vocabulary the storage layer partitions on, deliberately: a binding that cannot place a tf must refuse the frame rather than file it under a default, or one interval's bars end up in another interval's partition where nothing can distinguish them. Bucket alignment differs per interval — see semantics.md §2.2.

seq.description: Per-symbol monotonic sequence, shared with tick on the same symbol — both interleave on one topic, so one counter is what detects loss on that stream. Emitted as an unsigned 64-bit integer. See semantics.md §6.

sid.description: Publisher session id — the UTC epoch MICROsecond stamped at init.

ts.description: DLL receive-side wall clock, UTC epoch seconds. Latency measurement only. Must NOT be used for bucket alignment.

ts_utc.description: ts_str converted to UTC epoch by the DLL. 0.0 on parse failure. Cross-check only.

ts_str.description: Raw EL timestamp, yyyy-MM/dd-HH:mm:ss (24-hour). AUTHORITATIVE source for bucket_start: parse as America/New_York, convert to UTC. bucket_start is LEFT-labelled, covering [t, t+tf). See semantics.md §1 and §2.

vol.description: Total share volume for the bar — but only when pv >= 1. At pv 0 this is up-tick share volume alone. Double even though semantically integral. Meaningless for index/breadth symbols. See semantics.md §3.4.

bid.description: Bid, or null when no quote is available. EL supplies 0 from InsideBid during historical replay and for symbols that carry no quote at all (breadth indices); the publisher normalises any non-positive value to null so the wire states the absence rather than leaving every binding to remember that 0 means "absent". See semantics.md §3.

ask.description: Ask, or null when no quote is available. Same rule as bid.

tc.description: A trade count only on tf 1d, and even there it is under suspicion (semantics.md §3.4). Intraday a pv 1 publisher sends 0. Emitted as %.0f.
